description:
Edit repos/boredom-vessel/src/resolvers/vesselAdditionScaffoldDispatch.ts so that it checks the learned success rate of the template it is about to invoke, and declines to invoke it when that rate is decisively bad.

Anchor. The following line occurs exactly once in the file and carries TWO leading spaces. Insert the new block immediately above it, and leave the line itself and everything below it untouched:

  const dispatchResponse = await fetch(RUN_GOAL_URL, {

Behaviour of the new block.

Look up the learned statistics for the template named by the existing SCAFFOLD_TEMPLATE_ID constant. Build the base URL from `process.env.ACTIVITY_API_ENDPOINT`, defaulting to "http://127.0.0.1:8080" when unset, and request the path "/v2/activities/templates?limit=200". Send `Content-Type: application/json`, and when `process.env.METABOB_API_KEY` is a non-empty string also send an `Authorization` header of the word ApiKey followed by a space and that key. Parse the JSON body and scan its `templates` array for the entry whose identifier matches SCAFFOLD_TEMPLATE_ID after removing a leading "activity:" prefix and, if present, an enclosing pair of the mathematical angle brackets U+27E8 and U+27E9.

From the matched entry, read the two numbers `metrics.thompson_alpha` and `metrics.thompson_beta`. Take them from the nested `metrics` object only. The template object also carries a top-level `thompson_alpha`, which is a fixed prior of 1 and carries no learning; reading it instead would make this check meaningless.

Compute total as alpha plus beta and rate as alpha divided by total. Decline the invocation only when total is at least 100 AND rate is below 0.01. In every other situation proceed exactly as the file does today and call fetch as before. That includes: no matching template, a network error, an unparseable body, or either statistic missing or not finite. Never decline on missing data, because a template with no history would otherwise become permanently unreachable.

When declining, skip the fetch entirely, write one console line naming the template id together with alpha, beta and rate, and return the same result object the function already returns, reusing the shape constant and the already-computed vessel_name, port, advertised_shapes_literal, description, commit_message, pr_title and pr_body values. Set dispatched_at to the current time as an ISO string. Set dispatch_response to an object recording that the dispatch was declined, a reason of "posterior_decisively_negative", and the observed template id, alpha, beta and rate. The dispatch_response property is declared as unknown, so no interface change is required.

Motivation for the reviewer. This resolver invokes a template by hardcoded identifier directly against run-goal, which skips activity selection completely. The template it names currently carries a learned alpha near 6 against a beta near 8585, one success against roughly 7980 failures, and every one of its 2320 stored executions is a failure — yet it continues to be invoked, because nothing on this path ever reads that record. This change makes the resolver read it.

Restrict the work to this one file and to this single contiguous insertion.
